digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec and bidirectional sync
propositions: Cloud descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF rather than plain-text paragraphs through the production codec path.
Data Center descriptions and comments must render safe Markdown as Jira wiki markup without monotonic length decay over repeated passes through the production codec path.

Echo-safety mechanism using per-binding baseline, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way comparison must prevent endless re-emission of unchanged content and flag concurrent edits without silent overwrites.
Jira-authored native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive outbound reconciliation through origin-gated preservation in normalize_outbound.
DC renderer must fall back without content loss when pandoc is absent, times out, or encounters pathological input.
Comment sync must use an append-only local-to-Jira-comment-ID map routed through the same rich-text codec as descriptions, without edit or delete propagation.
